text: Which of the following is a Government of India platform for Open Educational Resources (OER) with QR-coded 'energised textbooks'?
textHi: निम्न में से कौन भारत सरकार का ओपन एजुकेशनल रिसोर्स (OER) प्लेटफ़ॉर्म है जिसमें QR-कोड युक्त 'ऊर्जित पाठ्यपुस्तकें' हैं?

options.whyIncorrect: UMANG is a unified app for accessing government services.
CoWIN was the COVID-19 vaccination platform.

explanation: DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing), launched 2017 by MoE/NCERT, hosts e-content, teacher courses (NISHTHA) and QR codes printed in NCERT/state textbooks. It became the 'One Nation One Digital Platform' under PM eVIDYA.
examRelevance: OER and digital platforms are named in the IT syllabus.

options.text: An online MOOC platform offering free courses from Class 9 to post-graduation
A hardware scheme to distribute tablets
A TV channel for school students
options.whyIncorrect: That is SWAYAM PRABHA — the DTH channel bouquet.
Not an exam portal (though SWAYAM courses have proctored exams).

explanation: SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds), launched 2017, provides MOOCs with four quadrants: video lecture, reading material, self-assessment tests, and discussion forum. SWAYAM PRABHA is the companion set of DTH educational channels.
examRelevance: Digital initiatives — expected in the 4-question IT section.

text: Which of the following is an INPUT device?
textHi: निम्न में से कौन इनपुट डिवाइस है?
explanation: Input: keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone, webcam, touchscreen (also output). Output: monitor, printer, speaker, projector. Storage: HDD, SSD, pen drive.

text: The 'TPACK' framework for integrating technology in teaching stands for:
textHi: शिक्षण में प्रौद्योगिकी एकीकरण का 'TPACK' ढाँचा किसका संक्षिप्त रूप है?
explanation: TPACK (Mishra & Koehler, 2006) describes the intersection of technology, pedagogy and content knowledge needed for effective technology-integrated teaching — the teacher must know WHAT to teach, HOW to teach it, and WHICH tool fits.
examRelevance: IT in teaching-skill development — conceptual item.

text: 'URL' in the context of the internet stands for:
textHi: इंटरनेट के संदर्भ में 'URL' का पूर्ण रूप है:
explanation: A URL is the address of a resource on the web, e.g., https://kvsangathan.nic.in — protocol (https), domain (kvsangathan.nic.in), path. Related: HTTP/HTTPS, WWW (Tim Berners-Lee, 1989), ISP, browser.
examRelevance: Abbreviations are common in the IT section.

text: In Uttar Pradesh, the 'Prerna' portal/app is used primarily for:
textHi: उत्तर प्रदेश में 'प्रेरणा' पोर्टल/ऐप का मुख्य उपयोग है:

options.text: Monitoring Basic Education — teacher attendance, school data, FLN learning outcomes ('Mission Prerna')

explanation: Mission Prerna (launched 2019) is UP Basic Education Department's flagship FLN programme; the Prerna portal/app (prernaup.in) is used for school monitoring, teacher digital attendance, learning-outcome tracking and 'Prerna Lakshya' goals for Classes 1–5. DBT for uniforms/books also runs through it.
source: prernaup.in — Basic Education Dept., Govt of UP
examRelevance: UP-specific education tech — highly relevant to the target post.
